cohort: 420 women undergoing cesarean section in advanced labor with deeply waged head at VSS Medical College and Hospital, Burla, Odisha, India between April 2012 and March 2015.
finding: The Patwardhan technique for cesarean section in the second stage of labor resulted in significantly fewer uterine incision extensions and blood transfusions compared to the push method.
followup_time: Duration of hospital stay was recorded, but specific follow-up time beyond that is not mentioned.
